name: Elise Dubois
bio:
Elise's journey into motorsport was a somewhat unconventional one, beginning with a fascination for automotive design and restoration. After completing her apprenticeship in automotive refinishing, she quickly gained a reputation for her meticulous attention to detail and her ability to create stunning, durable paint finishes. Her passion for racing led her to seek a position within motorsport, where she could combine her technical skills with her love for speed and competition. 

Joining Racing Bulls was a dream come true for Elise. She thrives on the challenge of applying cutting-edge paint technology to racing cars, ensuring both aesthetic appeal and aerodynamic performance. Elise is known for her innovative approach to paint application, always seeking new ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the paint shop. Her calm demeanor and unwavering commitment to quality make her a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle highlights
physical.description: Elise has a focused gaze and a warm, approachable smile.

quirks: Always meticulously cleans her spray gun after each use, regardless of how busy she is.
Listens to classical music while working to maintain focus.
Keeps a small notebook filled with color combinations and experimental paint techniques.
